notes: Full review of net/xdp (xsk.c 796 lines, xsk_queue.h 264, xsk_queue.c, xdp_umem.c, xdp_sock.h, uapi if_xdp.h) and both AF_XDP driver consumers in s02 (i40e_xsk.c, ixgbe_xsk.c). s02 is an early AF_XDP tree with no TX metadata support at all. All shared-memory descriptor fetches funnel through xskq_validate_desc/xskq_validate_addr which use READ_ONCE into a local struct that is both validated and consumed; xsk_umem_consume_tx then passes local copies (desc.addr/desc.len) to drivers. No double-fetch or missing-snapshot of any UMEM-resident field found. options field never read. Seed mechanism absent (xsk_skb_metadata does not exist in this tree).

xsk_umem_consume_tx uses validated local desc.addr/desc.len for dma/len
